provenance.paper_title: Planning from Imagination: Episodic Simulation and Episodic Memory for Vision-and-Language Navigation

evidence.paraphrase: Mixed-granularity memory updated during navigation and expanded through episodic simulation. memory/imagined viewpoints guide waypoint and action selection.
During operation, Planning from Imagination applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to episodic / trajectory memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

During operation, Planning from Imagination applies merging or deduplication of overlapping entries to episodic / trajectory memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
Topological memory updates at each navigation step. For Planning from Imagination, this specifically supports relinking or reindexing of stored items of episodic / trajectory memory.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (episodic / trajectory memory) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
